name: Consultation & Review
description: Every treatment journey at Nikoo Aesthetics begins here — a thorough, unhurried conversation about your goals, medical history and suitability, before any treatment is planned.

name: Botox
description: Anti-wrinkle treatment using premium brands — Azzalure, Botox and Alluzience — softening expression lines for a naturally refreshed look, plus targeted treatments for jawline slimming and excessive sweating.

name: Filler
description: Our full range of dermal filler treatments — lips, chin, jawline, cheeks and non-surgical rhinoplasty — using premium hyaluronic acid brands including Restylane, Juvederm and Revolax, tailored to your natural proportions.

name: Profhilo / Skin Boosters
description: Bio-remodelling and hydration treatments — Profhilo, Seventy Hyal and Polynucleotides — that work with your skin's own collagen and elastin for a natural, from-within glow.

name: Fat Dissolving
description: Lemon Bottle and Aqualyx injectable treatments to dissolve stubborn, localised fat deposits — most commonly used for double chin contouring.

name: Mesotherapy and Microneedling
description: Skin revitalisation treatments including Mesotherapy and PRP (Vampire Facial) — nourishing and rejuvenating the skin from within for improved texture, tone and radiance.
